Earthworm surface/shape and leaf odor/caption changes demand context-dependent reasoning; no real learner performance was observed.
observationsMadeBeforeExposure.SOURCE: Actual primary text and PNG pages 28-30 place the reflection bullet in section 3.1 at the end of grade 8. Actual 2022 pages 1-2 restrict the overall curriculum to grades 5-9 and separately change section 3.2 requirements to grade 9. The pig-eye preparation statement belongs to the latter context and must not be fused with this reflection bullet.
observationsMadeBeforeExposure.V: Original PNG and actual 360/680 browser captures were visually inspected. Two scenes retain an ordinary earthworm and the same learner; first-person thought bubbles are legible at 360. The learner observes with greater distance, without touching, danger or cure claims. This illustrates one response, with no universal guarantee that distance solves disgust.
